goal: Turn shard recall into a provenance-grounded content engine
body: Dave identified the next product/content arc: NouGenShards can now feed blogs and high-volume content from date-filtered historical evidence. Build around evidence-first generation: monthly/weekly retrospectives, project origin stories, tutorials, case studies, devlogs, timelines, product changelogs, and live commentary. Preserve provenance so later backfills and third-party research never masquerade as contemporaneous user activity. Done when the fleet has a repeatable shard→outline→draft→fact-check→publish pipeline with citations/traceability.

relay.note: Needs an actual shard→outline→draft→fact-check→publish content pipeline with citation/provenance tracking — new multi-step tooling, beyond relay-watch's file-only reach. Queued to the blade/claude-cli lane.

Reconciled complete against explicit acceptance evidence in the linked answer: shipped implementation, focused tests, and live proof where required. Optional follow-ons remain separate and do not invalidate this leg.
